_comment: Worked example. Copy to guide-config.json and edit. All paths are relative to THIS config file. 'assistant_name' is the voice guide's name (chosen in Phase 0). 'avatar' is its portrait. 'audio_mode': 'url' lazy-loads audio/<file> (recommended, light); 'inline' base64-inlines the clips into one self-contained file. 'anchors' inject ids onto the leaflet's section heads so a segment can scroll/highlight to them (match the exact HTML string). 'segments' = the narration: text + the element it scrolls to (target null = top; block = scrollIntoView start|center).

segments.text: Hi, I'm Ava. Let me walk you through this service. It only takes a few steps, and I'll explain each one as we go.
First, what you need before you start: your identity document and a few details about your request. Have them ready and the rest is quick.
Here's how it works. You fill in the form, the system checks it, and an officer reviews it. You can follow the progress at every stage.
And at the end, this is what you receive. When you're ready, you can begin, and I'm here whenever you need me.
